title: Calculate a quote in minor currency units
prompt:
Synthetic quote: 3 units at 12000 cents each. Apply a 10 percent discount to merchandise only, then add 1500 cents shipping. Tax is explicitly zero. Calculate the total.

Return only one JSON object with exactly these fields. subtotal_cents, discount_cents, total_cents: integers.
remediation_hints: Apply discounts to the specified base and reconcile quantity, freight and tax.
